rationale: The candidate reads as several small orange fragments distributed around a parcel, so the dominant gesture is not yet one legible gymnasium hall. Across the four views there is no coherent long-span body; instead the form appears split into disconnected wedges and bars, with visible collisions and inconsistent continuity between views. The blue access edge is not answered by a strong public threshold or carved entry court; the ground response is weak and semantically muted. Repair integrity is decent because the geometry still sits within the parcel and does not appear catastrophically broken, but the formal language is far from the program contract: a gymnasium needs one clear usable hall, subordinate support, and a roof/section that expresses span or daylight. Here the section reads more like arbitrary stepped fragments than a hall section, so program_fit_hard_pass fails.
